commands.command: 'Get-Content inputs/TASK.md; Get-ChildItem -Force; if (Test-Path .agents/skills) { Get-ChildItem .agents/skills -Recurse -File | Select-Object FullName }'
'Get-ChildItem inputs -Recurse -File | Select-Object FullName,Length; Get-Content inputs/intake.json; Get-Command python,conda -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source'

"python -c \"import zipfile,pathlib; [(print('\\nFILE',p.name),[(print(n, z.read(n).decode('utf-8'))) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml')]) for p in pathlib.Path('inputs').glob('*.do*') for z in [zipfile.ZipFile(p)]]\""
